evals.name: etag-update
evals.prompt: I need to update the billing email on our Forz customer cust_01J9ZK3 — change it to billing@acme.com.
evals.expected_output: Agent runs get first for the ETag, then update with --if-match.

evals.name: paginate-jobs
evals.prompt: Pull all the open jobs in Forz for customer cust_01ABC and save the full list to open-jobs.json.
evals.expected_output: Agent filters status=open, follows the cursor across pages, writes all jobs to open-jobs.json.

evals.name: idempotent-invoice
evals.prompt: Create an invoice in Forz from invoice.json for this customer. Heads up — I tried this earlier and the command timed out, so I'm not sure if it already went through. Whatever you do, don't double-bill them.
evals.expected_output: Agent checks for an existing invoice before creating, then creates; explains idempotency reasoning.
